design.Q_parameterization: Q_r=N(mu(r),r), mu(r)=sqrt(2*I+log(r)-r+1), positive mean branch; negative branch by sign symmetry

simulator.joint_event: F = {early candidate final conditional-SNML logC < early threshold AND adjacent late candidate final logC < late threshold}; early and late are computed from the same generated path, so dependence is retained directly.
simulator.snml_regret_increment: d_n=(n+1)/2 log n - n/2 log(n-1) - 1/2 log(2e) + log Gamma((n-1)/2)-log Gamma(n/2); r_b(N)=sum_{n=b+1}^N d_n
simulator.atomic_generation: partition the common early/late path at all candidate, burn-in and true-change boundaries; each homogeneous P/Q atom is generated via independent Gaussian sample mean and chi-square within-SSE, then aggregated exactly.
simulator.anchor_seed_rule: anchor insertion index j uses seedbase=10000000+j*1000; offset x uses that seedbase in the atomic shared-path simulator.

transport.pair_failure_bound: At each anchor and offset, one-sided Clopper-Pearson directly upper-bounds the JOINT neighboring-pair failure probability; no min-marginal relaxation is used.
transport.path_kl: For exact-level target r and anchor a, D(path_r||path_a)=(64-x) D_KL(Q_r||Q_a), because the complete shared path required by the adjacent H=48 pair contains 64-x post-change observations.
transport.binary_data_processing: For the joint-failure indicator, kl(p_target||p_anchor)<=D(path_target||path_anchor). If CP gives p_anchor<=u<0.09, any target satisfying (64-x)D_KL<=kl(0.09||u) has p_target<=0.09.
transport.cover_construction: For each anchor, intersect the transport interval over all 17 offsets; adaptively add anchors at uncovered log-r gaps until the union covers the full exact-level r interval. Root/merge computations are float64; interval endpoints are moved one ulp inward.
transport.coverage_result: single merged interval covers the complete exact KL=1 Gaussian level on the positive-mean branch; negative mean follows from global sign symmetry.
